notes.subject: fix(chat): keep a starting turn marked as streaming during preparation
notes.summary: Fixes a brief flash of "(No response)" in chat: a turn that is still preparing (hooks, checkpoint, memory recall) is now shown as streaming until the spinner appears.

notes.subject: feat(sdk): share VS Code's instructions, rules and skills with the CLI, Assistant and Ask Agent
notes.summary: The SDK, CLI, Assistant and Ask Agent now share VS Code's instruction, rule and skill discovery, adding load_skill, read_skill_resource and load_rule. The CLI replaces list_artifacts/load_artifact with these tools.

notes.subject: feat(approvals): start new project chats with Approve for Me on
notes.summary: Adds the agentlink.approveForMeByDefault setting (default on) so new project chats start with Approve for Me. Composer toolbar toggles keep a fixed width and no longer append "On".
